reviews.comment:
Mi puntuación es por la OFICINA ACA que funciona ahi V. gesell. Si bien quienes atienden resultan amables los últimos dos días vinieron en cualq hrio, por ej el 29 y 30/4 acortaron su jornada habitual q va 10 a 17 a 13 a 16.30. El día 29 está información no estaba y espere 2 horas sin ninguna orientación, y el día 30 ya con ese nuevo hrio la Sra llegó casi a las 14. Hay q atender a q brindan un servicio q no es suplido por otros lugares, y en la costa tenés esta oficina, Mar del Plata o Pinamar q es atendida por ellos mismos. Se entiende q malabarean por ser escaso recurso humano Pero el coletazo lo pagamos quienes somos usuarios. Espero que quien tenga autoridad sobre esta administración tome nota y accione

(Translated by Google)
My rating is for the ACA office located in Villa Gesell. While the staff are generally friendly, the last two days they arrived at random hours. For example, on April 29th and 30th, they shortened their usual hours (10:00 AM to 5:00 PM) to 1:00 PM to 4:30 PM. On the 29th, the information wasn't available, and I waited two hours without any guidance. On the 30th, with the new schedule, the woman arrived almost at 2:00 PM. It's important to note that they provide a service that isn't offered elsewhere, and on the coast, you have this office, or offices in Mar del Plata or Pinamar, which are staffed by the same people. It's understandable that they're juggling with limited personnel, but we, the users, are the ones who suffer the consequences. I hope that whoever is in charge of this administration takes note and takes action.
